[Shot 2] At 00:07.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1> from the side, with <Subject 2> blurred in the background. Her expression remains wary, lips closed after speaking, as dust drifts through the air. The camera holds steady on her face, emphasizing the contrast between her bright hair and the grey ruins.
